dogecoin.text: With all eyes on #DogeCoin and the unprecedented growth, do you think Doge is bubble waiting to burst?

🧵(4/5)

January 2021, Dogecoin spikes 800% to $0.07 in 24 hours.
 
February 2021, Dogecoin hit its all-time-high of $0.08 following tweets from celebrities
 
March 2021, Mark Cuban announced his NBA team would accept Dogecoin. 20,000 transactions were conducted in first 2 days

🧵(3/5)
 
March 2014, DogeCoin was updated to a static block reward instead of the randomized reward for each mined block.

April 2015, Jackson Palmer announced an "extended leave of absence".

January 2018, Dogecoin briefly reached a market cap of $2bn USD at $0.017/coin

🧵(2/5)
 
This growth occurred when Chinese banks were forbidden from investing in the Bitcoin economy. DogeCoin dropped by 80% 3 days later.

December 2013, millions of Dogecoin were stolen. The community started an initiative called "SaveDogemas" to help donate to victims.
